name: Gray Bear Tongue
summary: In Hillsbrad Foothills, Apothecary Lydon seeks gray bear tongues for the Royal Apothecary Society's experiments.

sections.title: Apothecary Research in Hillsbrad
sections.body: Gray bears roam the wilds around Tarren Mill in several sturdy varieties. Apothecary Lydon uses their tongues as a base ingredient for lethal solutions, including the Elixir of Suffering.

faq.answer: At Tarren Mill in Hillsbrad Foothills, Apothecary Lydon seeks gray bear tongues for experimental killing agents.

faq.q: What is the Apothecary using these tongues for?
faq.answer: Lydon uses gray bear tongues as a primary organic ingredient in the Elixir of Suffering. The concoction is designed to help plague Hillsbrad’s living human populations. Creeper ichor is another ingredient.
Gray bear tongues come from local gray bears in Hillsbrad Foothills: standard gray bears, elder gray bears, vicious gray bears, and Big Samras, a notorious beast.

angles.text: As an undead, you help the Royal Apothecary Society craft new plagues against the living. You gather organic components from local wildlife.
